workflow_runs.name: Bounded joint training support diagnostic
workflow_runs.display_title: Publish joint nuisance dispositions and historical score replays

head_commit.message:
Publish joint nuisance dispositions and historical score replays

Retain 78 complete joint-fit histories, one optimizer unknown and one wall-time failure. Matched raw broad/long total inhibition loses 1.2607 nats on average against the jointly fitted comparator; incomplete full-regime summaries stay unavailable.

Install the independently reviewed 235-page paper, eight-page guide and interactive disposition tables. Bind selected-state replay coverage to the new source, preserve historical evidence and refresh current production custody.

Validation: 981 distinct tests passed with no failures, errors or skips; claim, repository, input, mathematics and 80-selector checks passed. Linux candidate CI is reviewed separately before main promotion.
